items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, that reminds me, the other day I got on the bus and John Casimir was there.

ctx.x: Well, we had a repertoire that we played like, we played a lot of the old poplin numbers, like the girl that you married was one. We used to play rumbles. We played practically everything. During those days.

Oh, that reminds me, the other day I got on the bus and John Casimir was there. So we're sitting down talking, he says, you're telling me down on Bourbon Street they never play a waltz. I can't understand that, you know? Yeah. Well, naturally, down there they don't want any waltzes.
No, they want everything loud, you know, to attract people's attention.
